 Austin Reaves fills stat sheet Friday against Warriors 
 by Chris Schommer | Lakers Correspondent | Sun, Nov 1st 2026, 8:42pm EST 
 Austin Reaves filled the stat sheet for the Lakers Friday night, dishing out five assists, recording one steal, grabbing four rebounds, blocking one shot, and scoring 21 points (9-19 FG, 1-6 3PT, 2-2 FT) in a 112-95 loss to the Warriors. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Reaves continues a steady stretch on the offensive end of the floor, finishing with 16 or more points in each of his last five contests. The guard remains part of a dynamic backcourt tandem with Luka Doncic in the Los Angeles starting five, averaging 23.8 points, 1.2 steals, 3.5 rebounds, and 5.3 assists per game while posting a usage rate of 26.3% so far this season.
